timeline.summary: GSP Crop Science hosted its Q3 FY26 earnings conference call, reporting 9M revenue of ₹1,114 Cr and EBITDA of ₹153 Cr.
2026-04-29: ICRA upgraded GSP Crop Science's long-term rating to A+ (Stable) from A (Stable) and short-term to A1 from A2+ on ₹516.16 Cr of rated bank facilities.
GSP Crop Science approved the acquisition of the remaining 21% stake in its subsidiary GSP Intermediates for ₹3.15 Cr.
2026-05-15: CRISIL monitoring report showed GSP Crop Science had utilised ₹107.26 Cr of its ₹220.32 Cr IPO net proceeds by March 2026, including ₹107.64 Cr of GCP on a Tata Capital term loan.
Bhavesh Vrajmohan Shah, as Promoter of GSP Crop Science Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter shares as of March 31, 2026, with total promoter holding at 71.37%.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹402.46 Cr, net profit ₹19.64 Cr.
GSP Crop Science pledged 15,43,500 shares in subsidiary GSP Intermediates with Aditya Birla Capital Limited on May 26, 2026.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the AGM
